biggest_catch: The Slickdeals Cashback Beta is gone — the extension today is a coupon tool with a one-time $5 Target gift card for keeping it installed 30 days, not a cashback program that pays you for shopping.
catches: All 'Slickdeals Cashback' / 'SD Rewards' documentation dates to a 2021 beta ('we're working on speeding up this process as we continue to test out this Beta Program'); no current ongoing cashback program is documented.

The current extension landing page advertises only automatic coupon application plus a limited-time, one-time $5 Target gift card after 30 days of installation — an install incentive, not a payout mechanism with a minimum, method, and schedule.
One-time install incentives do not satisfy the route's claim of an ongoing cashback extension program.
The extension tracks your shopping to apply coupons — a privacy trade-off with no ongoing earnings on the other side.

c1.evidence: Slickdeals is a real company and its browser extension is live and installable; the extension page was loaded during this check.

c2.evidence: FAIL — the current official extension page contains no cashback program terms; the only offer is a limited-time, one-time $5 Target gift card for 30 days of installation.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to install the extension.

c4.evidence: FAIL — no current concrete payout mechanism exists: no ongoing cashback minimum, no payout method, no payment timing. The 2021 Cashback Beta pages are stale and the program is discontinued.

eligibility: Anyone can install the extension; there is no ongoing cashback program to be eligible for.
notes: REJECT is a discontinuation verdict, not a scam flag: Slickdeals is legitimate, but the 'Slickdeals Cashback (Beta)' program ended and what remains is a coupon extension with a one-time $5 Target gift-card install incentive. Do not list this route as verified unless Slickdeals relaunches an official ongoing cashback payout program.
